question: Which among following countries has the largest land area?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Canada.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Canada occupies most of the northern part of North America.
 
• The country occupies an area of **9,984,670 km²**, making it the largest country in the Western Hemisphere.
 
• Compared, it is slightly larger than the US, or 18 times the size of France.
 
• It has **13 sub-national divisions, ten provinces **and **three territories. **
 
• Canada is divided into multiple geographical regions, and its landscape offers a wide range of natural sceneries.
